_comment: windows.c add_menu() matches MENUCOLOR against the item's own text, before wintty.c tty_add_menu() prefixes it with "x - "; process_menu_window() then starts the color and attribute at attr_n = 4 for a line of that shape and at 0 otherwise. A lawful female dwarf asks for the role menu: "Archeologist"=cyan&inverse colors the role item from its fifth column. In the confirmation menu, the same rule colors the whole zero-identifier header line, "^Yes"=red&underline matches the label alone, and "^n - "=green&bold matches no item, because no add_menu() string carries the prefix. Bold, underline and inverse are used because the recorder drops blink, and the Archeologist item sits on row 4 because the scorer masks the row holding the startup version banner.
